caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden wall-mounted object, primarily brown in color, composed of several geometrically-shaped elements. At the top, there is a circular disc with a central hole, attached to a triangular section that has decorative, star-shaped projections on either side. Below this is a recessed, rectangular shelf area supported by side brackets. Continuing downward, there are two cylindrical holders positioned symmetrically, one on the left and one on the right. In the lower section, there is a wide, curved front piece with carved details and a subtle leaf motif, forming a shallow, tray-like compartment. A narrow rod runs horizontally near the base of this compartment, connecting both sides. The entire object has beveled and notched edges and features a consistent wood grain texture throughout, rendered in varying shades of brown and highlighted areas to suggest three-dimensionality. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Comb Wall Case
